title: Businesses in ChatGPT: Features and Pricing (2026)
summary: Businesses in ChatGPT is OpenAI's new beta offering for enterprises. You'll determine whether this affects your current automation strategy and how.
body_markdown:
## Businesses in ChatGPT launched on OpenAI's own page


Anything beyond it's inference, and I'll mark it as such, whether it comes from the announcement's own wording or from how comparable[Activepieces](https://www.activepieces.com/) style automation tools have been described elsewhere.


### What OpenAI released and when


OpenAI published the announcement on November 10, 2026, under its own byline, and it opens with "We're introducing Businesses in ChatGPT in beta."


**The beta label is the detail** that matters for planning. **Features, limits and access can change under you, so don't wire a production process to behavior the page doesn't state.**


You can't subscribe to a trigger or map a field into another system from anything the page documents. Until it does, treat this as a product launch, not an integration surface.


### Who it is for, per OpenAI


As the name says, the offering is aimed at businesses, and OpenAI frames it around the audience ChatGPT already has. For an automation team that means the people asking for it are inside your company, not waiting on a vendor roadmap.


You can't plan around hypothetical controls, though, so work from what the page confirms.


Treat the model call as one step among several. A flow built in[Activepieces](https://www.activepieces.com/) that passes a row through[Claude](https://claude.com/resources/articles/claude-team-updates) , ChatGPT and Perplexity, writing back to a spreadsheet after each, shows the shape of what you can build.


> Treat the model call as one step among several.


Activepieces is used by teams at companies including MoneyGram, Moneypenny, Alan and Funding Societies.


The trigger and the data live in your apps, and the model is a replaceable step.


That's the model to copy now, and the next section sets out how to connect it to your apps without waiting for more detail from OpenAI.
